SELECT gc.shop_id, gb.goods_id, gc.transport_template, gb.goods_cubage, gb.common_id, gb.goods_name, gb.cat_id, gb.goods_spec, gb.goods_price, gb.goods_market_price, gb.goods_image, gb.goods_is_shelves, gb.goods_max_sale, gs.goods_stock FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_base gb ON (gc.common_id = gb.common_id) LEFT JOIN ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_stock gs on gb.goods_id = gs.goods_id where 1 = 1
and gb.goods_id = #{goodsId,jdbcType=INTEGER}
select goods_id from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common where common_id = #{commonId}
select virtual_goods from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common where goods_id = #{goodsId}
select common_name from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common where common_id=#{commonId}

SELECT ggc.common_id, ggc.shop_id, ggc.shop_name, ggc.common_name, ggc.common_stock, ggc.common_price AS goodsPrice, ggc.common_image, ggc.goods_id FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common ggc WHERE ggc.common_id = #{commonId}

SELECT cat_id FROM ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common WHERE 1=1
and common_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{commonName },'%')
GROUP BY cat_id ORDER BY count(cat_id) DESC LIMIT 1

select gc.common_id,gc.common_name,gc.cat_name,gc.common_image,gc.common_price, gc.common_stock,gc.common_sell_time,gc.common_state,gc.dealer_goods_flag,gc.common_salenum, gc.common_verify,gc.common_is_shop_take,gc.common_verify_time,sb.shop_name, gc.shop_id,gc.virtual_goods,gc.is_gift_products,gc.fixed_rewards from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc left join ${database.prefix.supplier}hou_shop_base sb on gc.shop_id = sb.supplier_shop_id where gc.common_verify = 1 AND gc.common_is_screen = 1 AND gc.dealer_goods_flag = 0 AND sb.shop_self_support = 'true' AND gc.shop_status = 3 and gc.common_state = 1 and gc.is_gift_products = 0 and sb.shop_type = 1
and gc.shop_id = #{param.shopId}
and gc.common_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.commonId},'%')
and gc.common_state = #{param.commonState}
and sb.shop_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.shopName},'%')
and gc.common_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{param.commonName},'%')
order by gc.common_update_time desc

select common_id, common_name, goods_id, common_price, common_image, common_salenum, common_market_price, common_state, common_is_xian, common_promotion_tips, shop_id from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common where common_id = #{commonId}

select common_id, common_name, goods_id, common_price, common_image, common_salenum, common_market_price, common_state, common_is_xian, common_promotion_tips, shop_id from ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc where gc.common_state = 1 and gc.common_verify = 1 and gc.goods_type = 1 and gc.integral_goods = 1
and gc.common_id not in
#{item.commonId}
order by gc.common_salenum DESC, gc.common_evaluate DESC

select a.common_id, a.cat_id, a.create_time from ( select gc.common_id, gc.cat_id,gf.footprint_time as create_time from goods_user_footprint gf left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on gf.common_id = gc.common_id where gf.user_id = #{userId} and gc.common_state = 1 and gc.common_verify = 1 and gc.goods_type = 1 and gc.integral_goods = 1 UNION ALL select gc.common_id, gc.cat_id,og.order_goods_time as create_time from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_goods og left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on og.common_id = gc.common_id where og.buyer_user_id = #{userId} and gc.common_state = 1 and gc.common_verify = 1 and gc.goods_type = 1 and gc.integral_goods = 1 UNION ALL select gc.common_id, gc.cat_id,ug.favorites_goods_time as create_time from ${database.prefix.userms}hou_user_favorites_goods ug left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on ug.common_id = gc.common_id where ug.user_id = #{userId} and gc.common_state = 1 and gc.common_verify = 1 and gc.goods_type = 1 and gc.integral_goods = 1 UNION ALL select gc.common_id, gc.cat_id,oc.insert_cart_time as create_time from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_user_cart oc left join ${database.prefix.goods}hou_goods_common gc on oc.common_id = gc.common_id where oc.user_id = #{userId} and oc.cart_status = 0 and gc.common_state = 1 and gc.common_verify = 1 and gc.goods_type = 1 and gc.integral_goods = 1 ) a order by a.create_time limit 50
